$comment: Ratchet baseline for `astro check --minimumSeverity error`. This number may only go DOWN. tests/typecheck-baseline.typecheck.ts fails if it rises (a regression) and also fails if it drops (so the baseline is retightened rather than quietly leaving slack). Run `pnpm test:types` to check, then lower `total` to the reported count.
